records.notes: Visible forms preserve إِسْرَائِيلَ; alif and madd presentation differs.
Difference is initial hamza/alif presentation in ءَاخَرِينَ versus اٰخَرِينَ; no subtype asserted.
The editions visibly divide between وَيَقُولُ, يَقُولُ, and وَيَقُولَ forms.
Warsh and Qalun visibly use يَرْتَدِدْ while the other forms use يَرْتَدَّ.
Visible alif, madd, and stopping-mark differences in لَائِمٍ are preserved without subtype assertion.
